title: SKU-aware heatstrip: token pricing lens & export flow
creator: Asha Kumar
description: Goal: Design an exploratory and exportable console view that surfaces token-level unit economics while tying costs to SKU/pricing rules and rollout variants. The view ("heatstrip") should let customers: 1) compare per-token costs across SKU tiers and quantization/latency tradeoffs, 2) attribute cost to routes, prompts, and billing SKUs, and 3) export canonical CSV / BigQuery-ready payloads for downstream billing systems. The UX must support both a concise dashboard card and a deep dive page (interactive heatstrip + time-sliced attribution table) and integrate with rollout controls so customers can project cost impact of canary or A/B model variants.
comments: 2025-02-15 — initial concept wireframes uploaded to Figma; included a compact 'card' and full 'heatstrip' page. Feedback: PM asks for clearer SKU naming and a way to compare projected cost delta for rollouts.
2025-02-16 — engineering sync: confirmed backend can provide per-token shapes and SKU tags; need API change to deliver 'pricing_rule_id' in cost events. ENG dependency created (ENG-18239).

2025-02-17 — design critique: prefer time-slice scrubber over multi-select date filters for quicker comparisons. Accessibility notes added (color palette with patterned fills for colorblind-safe heatstrip).
2025-02-18 — prototype V1 (Figma) shared with PM and Product Ops; requested CSV and BigQuery export templates plus a 'pricing sandbox' modal to simulate discounts/commits.

2025-02-19 — review from Security: confirm exports don't include PII or full prompts; design updated to mask prompt text by default in export and include opt-in checkbox for full prompt export if allowed by deployment policy.
2025-02-20 — design ready for handoff to frontend; awaiting ENG-PR & unit tests. Preparing Handoff doc with API contract and example CSV rows.

Design notes: keep card-level summaries < 3 metrics: avg unit price, 7d cost delta, and projected monthly runrate. Deep view shows heatstrip (token buckets on y axis, time on x axis), attribution waterfall by route, and export controls.
decisions: Use SKU-aware unit-price column on every cost row to make pricing rules first-class in the view.
Default exports mask prompt text; full prompt export requires explicit admin opt-in per workspace.
Provide two export formats: canonical CSV (billing-friendly) and BigQuery JSON newline-delimited for analytics teams.
Integrate a 'pricing sandbox' modal to simulate commit discounts and autoscaling impacts against a selected time window.
Heatstrip color encoding will use patterned fills + color to be WCAG-compliant and readable for colorblind users.
